courses.note: Elective in the systems area (330-335); the major requires no OS or security course and C3 is already the algorithms course. COMP 332 is the systems-area course with public pages in several terms (2018, 2023, 2024); the newest is Spring 2024, so older is true. The home page (v2c-wesleyan-C6.txt) has no AI text; the AI rule is on the policies page.

notes: The major has no single required algorithms or systems course. The core asks for one course from each of four areas (models of computation 300-305, algorithms 310-315, programming languages 320-325, systems 330-335). COMP 312 is used for C3 because the catalog names it as the algorithms-analysis course.
